issues.title: [M0] Freeze specification and U/T traceability
issues.summary: Version v1.0 is the user-reviewed requirements baseline; keep software versions separate; map every requirement to tests.

issues.title: [M0] Decide Rust/Qt binding, toolchain and IPC schema
issues.summary: Evaluate Qt Widgets/Quick and Rust bindings on each target CPU/OS, using an IPC prototype.

issues.title: [M0] Design format-neutral Canonical Board Model
issues.summary: Common layers, real copper, vias, pads, geometry IDs, transform, connectivity and source provenance. ODB++ is not the core format.

issues.title: [M0] Prototype non-blocking worker and run snapshot
issues.summary: Independent solver process, asynchronous messages, heartbeat, cancellation, late response and crash isolation.

issues.title: [M0] Establish three native platform toolchain probes
issues.summary: Windows x64/ARM64 and macOS Apple Silicon build and runtime proof; record versions and constraints.

issues.title: [M0] Qualify public test fixtures, security and baseline PC
issues.summary: Only synthetic or redistributable data; approved samples and hashes, no company artwork or derived private results.

issues.title: [M1] Detect formats and summarize G/N/P/S/R/M readiness
issues.summary: Content signature and revision, incomplete inputs, normalized geometry provenance, safe archive/parse budgets.

issues.title: [M1] Implement PADS Layout ASCII importer
issues.summary: Trace/via/pad/net/layer parsing, correct coordinates and sample-based revision/coverage tests.

issues.title: [M1] Implement ODB++ Design importer
issues.summary: ODB++ is a source adapter only. Import step/instance, feature polarity, padstacks, copper, layer mapping, nets and substrate geometry with explicit supported revisions and cross-format tests.

issues.title: [M1] Implement asynchronous 2D artwork/net/layer viewer
issues.summary: Render shared canonical geometry; pan/zoom and select nets while import and solver remain cancelable.

issues.title: [M1] Implement Stackup, materials and reference editing
issues.summary: No silent FR4 substitution; material provenance, layer order and scenario geometry invalidation.

issues.title: [M1a] Model PCB and substrate vias/pads/anti-pads
issues.summary: Pad-to-Pad geometry with die-side and land-side references; exclude bumps, copper pillars, solder balls and bond wires.

issues.title: [M1b] Implement auto/manual Single and Differential ports
issues.summary: Single 2-Port and differential physical 4-Port with explicit P/N, source/load, terminal plane and reference.

issues.title: [M1b] Implement P001-P012 strict validation errors
issues.summary: Error prevents Run; reimport, reference cutout, pair reversal, branch and termination validation.

issues.title: [M2] Develop validated RLGC and transmission-line core
issues.summary: Uniform microstrip/stripline and coupled lines, numerical stability, model applicability and independent calculation.

issues.title: [M2] Implement direct sweep, DC and Touchstone export
issues.summary: DC handling, full complex S matrix, mixed-mode port mapping, complete and independent Touchstone roundtrip.

issues.title: [M2a] Implement Progressive Sweep and Region convergence
issues.summary: Midpoints computed directly, previously solved points reused, independent Group×Region status and off-grid verification.

issues.title: [M2a] Implement live graphs, model and limit statuses
issues.summary: Keep run, convergence, model, provenance, limit axes distinct; no premature global PASS.

issues.title: [M2b] Implement RAM/SSD cache and crash-safe snapshots
issues.summary: Separate physical result cache from convergence state; schema, atomic chunks, checksum and resume.

issues.title: [M2b] Stress-test GUI, cancel, heartbeat and SSD failure
issues.summary: Measure specified UX latency, cancel, IPC failures, memory and disk exhaustion, persistent restart.

issues.title: [M2c] Independently validate substrate discontinuities
issues.summary: Only measured/EM-validated via/pad models get Validated classification; unsupported otherwise.

issues.title: [M3] Add IPC-2581, KiCad and Gerber input adapters
issues.summary: Adapter support matrices, associated Drill/IPC-D-356 and layer mapping; Gerber-only cannot guarantee a solver-ready netlist.

issues.title: [M4] Evaluate Altium, Allegro, EAGLE and EasyEDA paths
issues.summary: Distinguish direct, offline converted, geometry preview and unsupported for each revision.

issues.title: [M5] Optimize performance and future model coverage
issues.summary: Future optional GPU and validated models after measured precision and speed comparisons.
